versions.changelog:
amazon-deep-research-v4 1.0.0-beta.1 — Initial beta release

- Provides end-to-end Amazon product research workflow with deep source cross-validation across AMZScout (fees), Xiyou Keyword, SellerSprite (BSR/metrics), Amazon official data, and 1688 image-based sourcing.
- Real-time USD/CNY exchange rate fetched at every run for accurate cost conversion.
- 7-item gross margin calculation with detailed cost breakdown; products under 20% margin or with HIGH IP risk are filtered out.
- Automatic WIPO IP compliance audit for trademarks and patents; only LOW and MEDIUM risk included.
- Generates comprehensive HTML report with all key metrics, sources, and margin analysis; all data sources are clearly labeled per value.
- Strict enforcement: only live, cross-verified data, Amazon image-based 1688 match, and rejection of placeholder/estimated data and international 1688 links.
